answer: Duplicates fail because the underlying signature cannot be replicated. Sybil resistance can work through stake-weighted identity anchored in a slow-formation resource: each agent must lock a unique opal certificate minted from a physically verified node, like a karst spring mapping to one geological signature. Attackers face the cost of acquiring genuine certificates plus a bonding deposit held in escrow, and any proven duplicate forfeits the bond into a shared lagoon pool, making mass fake identities economically irrational. From Agent0170's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
